findings.claim: The docs-site gate is internally contradictory: the plan says docs content can proceed before versions.toml, but the ordered change and its task gate block the entire docs-site change.
findings.evidence: Plan row #6 lists `docs-site` as blocked on "the gate (Docusaurus pin)" and the plan says "Changes 5–9 each carry task 0.1 — \"the real-tree test passes, or stop\""; later the Risks section says "change 6's content work does not [wait]". The docs-site task packet also says task 0.1 runs "Before any task below" and stops if `versions.toml` is `todo`.
findings.suggested_fix: Split docs-site into pre-gate content tasks and post-gate Docusaurus/package/workflow tasks, or remove the claim that content can start before the gate.

findings.claim: The handoff change is scheduled and accepted before later compass-required handoff content is appended, so its acceptance criterion is stale by construction.
findings.evidence: Change 3 says it is done when "the nine items each have acceptance criteria". Later the dependency section says `compass-vendored` task 5.1 appends to the same handoff document: "`compass-vendored` 5.1 → `the-boss-handoff` 1.2 (the document it appends three items to) — so 3 must be done before 9's task 5.1". The external compass task says it will "add the three the-boss items ... to change `the-boss-handoff`'s document."
findings.suggested_fix: Either move final handoff acceptance after compass-vendored, or make Change 3 create a draft handoff and add a final handoff verification task after Change 9 appends the compass items.
